verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents session management that preserves browser state for multi-step crawling and session re-use. JS execution can drive the page, and persistent browser profiles store authentication state and cookies, which together cover continuing to work on a page and getting past a login wall. Clicking and form filling are only implied through JS execution and hooks, not shown directly. missing for 10: an explicit documented click/form-fill interaction API or example, a login-flow walkthrough, independent hands-on corroboration.
